trigger: PyYAML not importable by C:\Python314 on Wee Tam -> fallback `pip install --user --require-hashes -r requirements-ci.txt` installs meson 1.12.0 into the shared runner identity's user site, which precedes site-packages on sys.path
classification_rationale: the step's own comment said it never pip-installs into the shared host Python, while its --user branch still changed what every later job's C:\Python314 imports. sre additionally argued an I6(a) false-assurance raise to HIGH; moot, fixed before merge.
summary: Copied from ci.yml's identical guard, so also pre-existing there. Raised independently by security-guardian, build-ci, release-deploy, cross-platform, unhappy-path, consistency-auditor and sre in the same parallel wave (sys.path ordering checked locally on CPython 3.14 by unhappy-path/security-guardian). Fixed in 4b5d40ae6: release.yml and ci.yml Windows steps fail closed on missing PyYAML and install nothing.

trigger: meson's find_program('python3','python') resolving to an interpreter other than the `python` the step probes (MSYS2 python3 or another python3 earlier on PATH)
classification_rationale: claim that the probe checks a different interpreter than meson uses
summary: Also raised by security-guardian (S2) and unhappy-path (UP-6/UP-11). Rejected on host evidence recorded by the author (read-only SSH, 2026-09-29): Wee Tam has no MSYS2 python (usr/bin, mingw64, ucrt64) and C:\Python314 ships no python3.exe; a WindowsApps python3.exe store alias exists for the runner identity, but Windows CI passes meson.build's configure-time `import yaml` probe on this host, so meson's resolved interpreter is not the alias and has PyYAML. Non-gating band, so no independent adjudicator is required for `rejected`.

trigger: a reader of docs/dependency-updates.md after this change
classification_rationale: the doc said release.yml's Windows build installs from requirements-ci.txt, which this change made false
summary: Fixed in 4b5d40ae6: the doc now says Windows jobs install nothing from requirements-ci.txt and that a meson bump there does not reach Windows until the contract and runner are updated.

trigger: a reader of release.yml's env comment
classification_rationale: comment said the meson pin lives in requirements-ci.txt; the Windows leg uses the toolchain contract's pin
summary: Also raised by unhappy-path (UP-9). Fixed in 4b5d40ae6.

trigger: step named 'Check ...' while it could still install
classification_rationale: step label vs behaviour
summary: Resolved in 4b5d40ae6: the step installs nothing and is named 'Verify Meson, PyYAML and ccache (pre-provisioned)'.

trigger: pwsh absent so the runner falls back to Windows PowerShell 5.1, where `2>$null` under Stop throws
classification_rationale: implicit shell dependency
summary: Fixed in 4b5d40ae6 with an explicit `shell: pwsh`.

trigger: a machine-wide pwsh profile setting $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference=$true
classification_rationale: probe could throw instead of falling to the error branch
summary: Fixed in 4b5d40ae6: the step sets $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false before the probe (verified in pwsh 7.2/7.4/7.5 containers by cross-platform).

trigger: PR #5115 body claimed no other workflow pip-installs into the Windows host Python
classification_rationale: instructions-windows-validate.yml did a bare pip install pyyaml on Wee Tam
summary: Fixed by fixing the cause (5c27d9076 removed that install) and rewriting the PR description before merge.

trigger: a reader of docs/ci-ubuntu-2604-cutover.md
classification_rationale: says requirements-ci.txt pins meson 1.11.1; it pins 1.12.0
summary: Out of this change's scope.

trigger: manual dispatch of instructions-windows-validate.yml on Wee Tam when python3 lacks PyYAML: `pacman -S python-yaml || pip install pyyaml` (unpinned, unhashed) into the shared host
classification_rationale: shared-host package install outside the toolchain contract, on the host that also runs release signing
summary: Band disputed: round-1 security-guardian derived HIGH (I1, asking for adjudication of whether I1 covers supply-chain pinning); round-2 security-guardian derived INFO (I9); build-ci rated LOW (and showed it would install MSYS2 python3, hijacking meson's find_program('python3') on the box). Not adjudicated: the operator chose to fix it in this PR instead. Fixed in 5c27d9076 (fail closed, no install), message refined in 546cd6352.

trigger: release.yml/ci.yml macOS steps pip3 --break-system-packages (no --user), pipx and brew on shared BigMags; --user installs into shared ~/.local on Big Tam, with branches carrying different pins
classification_rationale: same defect class as this change on other shared pools
summary: Also raised by security-guardian (P3) and release-deploy (Q4). Split: its own review unit per pool.

trigger: host toolchain drifts (e.g. a job upgrades meson); detected only when a PR job fails
classification_rationale: no scheduled check exists; not one of the six required-doc categories, so this is a capability follow-up, not I7
summary: Split: new scheduled workflow is an independent surface.

trigger: on-call facing a bricked Wee Tam slot (stray epmd) or drifted meson with no documented recovery
classification_rationale: no Wee Tam shared-host recovery section; not a required doc under the six categories (sre said so explicitly)
summary: Made more urgent by this change (missing PyYAML now fails closed). The error text half (drain + elevated re-provision) was fixed in 56318832d; the runbook itself is filed.

trigger: a self-hosted slot that fails jobs in seconds is idle first and keeps winning jobs (Wee Tam r0, 2026-09-29)
classification_rationale: no guard exists
summary: Also raised by unhappy-path (UP-11). Observed on runs 36606961510 and 36607188023.

trigger: ccache or Inno Setup absent on Wee Tam -> machine-wide unpinned winget install from the release job
classification_rationale: shared-host mutation from a job
summary: Also raised by release-deploy (Q4).

trigger: PyYAML missing from C:\Python314 (re-bake, reinstall) now fails every Windows job closed; the toolchain contract does not check PyYAML, and the provisioner installs ninja/pyyaml unpinned and unhashed
classification_rationale: contract has no PyYAML entry
summary: unhappy-path UP-9/UP-10 (Gate 8) and security-guardian S3. Split: contract + provisioner change is an independent surface.

classification_rationale: pre-release.yml's image list disagrees with release.yml's published images (verified by the author against origin/dev)
summary: Pre-release QA is expected to go red after rc2.

summary: Also unhappy-path UP-8. Existing issue #4911 (not roadmap-parked) covers it; evidence and a tripwire proposal were added there.

classification_rationale: absolute claim false across Wee Tam workflows at that commit
summary: Also build-ci N1. Fixed in 56318832d (scoped to 'this job'); the underlying install was removed in 5c27d9076.

trigger: on-call follows the ::error:: literally; Provision-Windows-Runner.ps1 aborts while any runner is live and needs an elevated session
classification_rationale: remedy text incomplete, not false
summary: Fixed in 56318832d: drain every slot, re-run elevated, never -AllowActiveRunners.

trigger: a reader of ci.yml's env comment
classification_rationale: comment said the meson pin lives in requirements-ci.txt; ci.yml's Windows job uses the contract pin
summary: Fixed in 56318832d to match release.yml's comment.

trigger: manual dispatch of the instructions gate on Wee Tam: python3 is only a WindowsApps store alias, so the new fail-closed step always fails and no provisioning path supplies a python3
classification_rationale: the error's remedy named a provisioning path that does not exist
summary: Also unhappy-path (Gate 8, I6 MEDIUM). Accepted scope (stop shared-host mutation) does not require making this manual workflow runnable; doing so changes instructions-tests.sh for local developers too, an independent surface, so split. The ::error:: now names the real cause and cites the issue (546cd6352).

trigger: an operator running instructions-tests.sh by hand on Wee Tam without PyYAML is told to run `pacman -S python-yaml`, which would install MSYS2 Python machine-wide
classification_rationale: hint directs a named damaging action on the shared host
summary: Also consistency-auditor (I8, LOW) and build-ci (note). Recorded at the strongest stated fact (I4 -> HIGH) rather than adjudicated down; unreachable in CI because the workflow step fails first. Fixed in 546cd6352: advice scoped to developer machines, shared CI runners told to fix provisioning.

trigger: instructions gate's Stop processes step kills yuzu-agent.exe/yuzu-server.exe by image name on a host whose four slots share one identity; fixed ports 18080/50054
classification_rationale: violates the #1871 shared-resource salting invariant
summary: Outside this change's scope.
